轻轻的绒毛、小小的钩子，都能帮种子离开妈妈身边。选一种，再送它一程。: Fluffy hairs and tiny hooks can help seeds leave their parent plant. Pick one and send it on its way.
先猜一猜：没有风时，小降落伞会去哪儿？: Guess: where will the tiny parachute go without wind?
里面藏着种子的小果实: A little fruit with a seed inside
带着种子的果实搭上顺风车: The seed-filled fruit catches a ride
没有风，它主要往下落。有风时，空气能把它带向旁边。: Without wind it mostly falls downward. Moving air can carry it sideways.
风把小果实带走了！绒毛增加空气阻力，让它有更多时间被风带着走。: The wind carries the little fruit! Its hairs add air resistance, allowing more time to drift.
先调风，再按出发。看看小果实在哪里落下或经过。: Set the wind, then press Off we go. Watch where the fruit falls or travels.
牛蒡的小钩子挂在毛上，跟着动物一起走。以后脱落，种子可能到了新地方。: Burdock hooks catch fur and travel with the animal. Later the burr can fall off in a new place.
牛蒡的小钩子已经挂住毛发。按出发，让动物带它走一段。: The hooks have caught the fur. Press Off we go to let the animal carry them.
蒲公英被风传播的单位是含一粒种子的小果实，冠毛增加阻力，降低沉降速度。牛蒡带钩的: A dandelion disperses a one-seeded fruit. Its pappus increases drag and slows descent. Burdock’s hooked bracts attach to fur or clothing and carry fruits with them. Eating fruit and later passing seeds is another form of animal dispersal.
箭头和移动距离只是传播方式示意，没有计算风速、湍流或真实落点。走得远不保证发芽，: Arrows and distances illustrate dispersal, without computing wind speed, turbulence or real landing sites. Travel does not guarantee germination: suitable conditions still matter. Fruits and fur are enlarged.
风、流水和动物能帮助种子旅行。不同形状适合不同的旅行方式。: Wind, water and animals help seeds travel. Different shapes work with different kinds of transport.
和大人观察粘扣带怎样挂住毛圈，再看看牛蒡果实的小钩子。只观察，不往宠物身上粘果实: With a grown-up, see how hook-and-loop fasteners catch fabric loops. Compare them with burdock hooks. Observe without attaching burrs to pets.
